reasons: Lake identity confirms United States v. Capers, 2d Cir., decided 2010-12-01, docket 09-2101, cluster_id 180156.
Lake citations confirm official citation 627 F.3d 470 and vendor citations 2010 U.S. App. LEXIS 24516 and 2010 WL 4869768.
No disclosed treatment edge says the case was overruled, superseded, abrogated, or limited.
residual_risks: Lake treatment and progeny are unverified/null, so this is not an affirmative current-good-law certification.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Keep the unverified-treatment banner adjacent to the citation whenever displayed.

reasons: Lens B does not test curation support for the home-role label.

No disclosed adverse treatment undermines use of Capers on that home page.
residual_risks: Whether Key is the right editorial role is outside Lens B.

reasons: Lake identity lists court as 2d Cir., court_level as coa, and circuit as ca2.
Lake official citation is 627 F.3d 470, supporting a published federal appellate authority-weight label for the Second Circuit.
No disclosed treatment edge removes or limits binding in-circuit weight; the page separately marks treatment as Unverified.
residual_risks: Binding weight should not be treated as verified good-law status because the lake treatment/progeny fields are unverified.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Display authority weight together with Treatment: Unverified to avoid implying citator-verified current validity.
